propositions: Pass-1 pass functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) discard per-call LLM usage attached by runner.run, so token totals never reach coverage.metrics or sidecar output
Per-criterion request/call counts extracted in runner._extract_usage are never persisted, blocking data-driven criterion demotion

Usage from pass-1 calls must be threaded as new return-value pairs through sizing.pass1_with_ladder, pass1._chunk, container fan-out, ISF handler, and prerequisite finder while updating all external callers (eval_solver, criterion_preview, fidelity_spot_eval)
Multi-criterion chunks must divide token fields equally across covered criteria while counting llm_calls and requests in full per criterion; ladder retries must each contribute a call record
Sidecar payload must expose coverage.usage with per_call (raw call records with criteria lists) and per_criterion (derived map) keys for observability
